n expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and every

s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend

- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Set

com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owne
r or admin.**\n- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the

he public API.\n- [List projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-projects.md): Projects the caller can access.

d/args/env and raw headers are never exposed.\n- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list

n routes take.\n- [List chat sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-chat-sessions.md): Chat sessions visible

uest`. Pagination rides in RESPONSE HEADERS rather than the body so the payload stays a valid OTLP document: read `x-mcpjam-next-c
ursor` and feed it back as `cursor`, and treat `x-mcpjam-export-complete: true` as the end of the stream.\n- [List a project's cli
ents](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/list-a-projects-clients.md): The clients saved in the project: the named, reus

ate a client (from a template or a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-from-a-template-or-

ack to the bundled SDK catalog snapshot if the live catalog…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a

t.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it: th
